questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign tells you to obey an important rule. This sign means slower drivers should stay in the right lane and keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where bicycles, animals, or pedestrians are likely to cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance ahead. It shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass in feet and inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right first, then left. Slow down and be ready for these curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane ahead. Check your mirrors and side. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers clear space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop at the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up so you can prepare for traffic or prepare to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are near a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns that one lane is ending and you need to merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards just ahead. These may include changes in traffic direction, steep slopes, or other dangerous situations that need your attention.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle means yield. Slow down to a safe speed for existing conditions and stop if needed. If you must stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn about hazards or special conditions ahead. Orange warning signs usually indicate construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must obey. This sign posted at an intersection means you cannot turn right or left when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign means traffic may be merging from the right. Be ready to allow these vehicles to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign requires you to drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to alert drivers to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn carts, and farm equipment display this emblem to warn drivers they are traveling at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.
